routes.name: Visa-free tourist stay
routes.summary: Many nationalities can enter without a visa. The immigration officer sets the length of stay at the border. Tourists can get up to six months in a calendar year, case by case.

other: Passport valid beyond the planned stay, valid return ticket, enough funds, and a confirmed hotel booking or sponsor.

EU passport holders are listed as exempt. The official country-by-country list is a 2017 PDF with internal conflicts, so check the exact rule for your passport with the Passport and Immigration Office before traveling.
Taiwan passports are not recognized, but Taiwan holders can get a 60-day visa on arrival.
The site links a Mauritius All-in-One Travel Digital Form (safemauritius.govmu.org). Its rules were not confirmed.

stay.note: Up to six months in a calendar year, decided case by case by immigration at entry.

routes.name: Business visit
routes.summary: Business visitors can stay up to 120 days per calendar year, and no more than 90 days per trip. You can't be paid in Mauritius. Multiple entry is for foreign business people with a business interest in Mauritius.

other: No paid work in Mauritius.
Business visitors who want to work or invest apply for an Occupation Permit through the Economic Development Board.

stay.note: 120 days per calendar year, max 90 days per trip.

sources.label: Passport and Immigration Office: Visa Requirements

routes.name: Transit
routes.summary: Transit is for passengers continuing to a third country within 24 hours.

other: Must continue to a third country within 24 hours. Airside transit rules were not listed on the page.

sources.label: Passport and Immigration Office: Visa Requirements

routes.name: Premium Visa
routes.summary: A one-year renewable visa for foreigners who want a long stay as a tourist, retiree or professional with family, including people running a business or working remotely from Mauritius. It's free. Apply through the Economic Development Board.

other: Eligibility criteria and any income threshold were not on the page read. Check the EDB Premium Visa page.

steps: Apply on the Economic Development Board Premium Visa page (edbmauritius.org/premium-visa).

sources.label: Passport and Immigration Office: Premium Visa

routes.name: Occupation Permit: Investor
routes.summary: Combined work and residence permit for investors, valid up to 10 years and renewable. The EDB says the minimum initial investment is USD 100,000, with turnover targets from year three.

other: Business turnover of at least MUR 5 million from the third year of registration, and MUR 8 million from the fifth year for renewal (EDB newsletter, announced in the budget speech).
An older government page lists different turnover targets (MUR 2 million in year one, MUR 10 million cumulative over the next two years), so confirm current rules with the EDB.

routes.name: Occupation Permit: Self-Employed
routes.summary: Work and residence permit for self-employed professionals, up to 10 years and renewable. The EDB says business income must reach MUR 2 million a year from the third year.

other: Business income of at least MUR 2 million a year from the third year of operation, and MUR 3 million a year from the fifth year for renewal (EDB newsletter).
An older government page lists a USD 35,000 initial investment and lower income targets. Confirm current rules with the EDB.

routes.name: Occupation Permit: Professional
routes.summary: Work and residence permit for employed professionals. It's issued for a maximum of three years or the length of the contract, and is renewable. The EDB says the minimum basic salary is MUR 50,000 a month.

income.note: Minimum basic monthly salary per EDB newsletter. An older page said above MUR 60,000, or MUR 30,000 for ICT.

other: Young Professional Occupation Permit: for recent graduates of a Tertiary Education Commission recognized institution, applied for within 6 months of results. The employer applies to the EDB.

stay.note: Maximum three years or the employment contract length.

sources.label: Passport and Immigration Office: Occupation Permit
Economic Development Board: Occupation Permit update

routes.name: Retired Non-Citizen Residence Permit
routes.summary: Residence permit for retirees, valid three years and renewable. You must be in Mauritius and apply in person at the EDB's Occupation Permit unit.

other: Age and income thresholds were not found on an official page I could read, so they are left out. Check the EDB or Passport and Immigration Office.

steps: Apply in person at the Occupation Permit unit.

sources.label: Defence and Home Affairs: Residence Permit and Visa

routes.name: Property-based Residence Permit
routes.summary: For non-citizens who hold residential property under the Property Development Scheme, Integrated Resort Scheme or Real Estate Scheme with an acquisition value of at least USD 500,000.

investment.note: Minimum acquisition value of qualifying property.

other: Rules may have changed since this page was written. Confirm with the EDB.

sources.label: Defence and Home Affairs: Residence Permit and Visa

routes.name: Residence Permit as spouse of a citizen
routes.summary: A residence permit is available to the spouse of a Mauritian citizen. Apply to the Passport and Immigration Office.

other: Must be married to a Mauritian citizen. Detailed requirements were not on the page read.

sources.label: Defence and Home Affairs: Residence Permit and Visa

routes.name: Permanent Residence Permit
routes.summary: Granted for 10 years under the Immigration Act. Occupation Permit holders need at least 3 years on the permit plus a category threshold.

other: At least 3 years on an Occupation Permit.
Investors: MUR 15 million annual turnover. Professionals: MUR 150,000 monthly basic salary. Thresholds may have been updated, so confirm with the EDB.

sources.label: Passport and Immigration Office: Occupation Permit
Defence and Home Affairs: Residence Permit and Visa

routes.name: Naturalisation
routes.summary: Adults of good character can apply after 12 continuous months of residence right before applying, plus at least 5 years total in the 7 years before that. You need adequate English or another local language and must intend to keep living in Mauritius.

eligibility.language: Adequate knowledge of English or another language used in Mauritius
other: Good character.
Knowledge of citizen responsibilities.
Temporary permit holders are outside this section.

citizenship.note: 12 months continuous plus 5 years in the prior 7. The Act only describes renunciation of a second nationality, so dual citizenship rules are not confirmed.

sources.label: Mauritius Citizenship Act (as amended 2022)

routes.name: Citizenship by marriage
routes.summary: A non-citizen married to a citizen can apply after at least 4 years living together in Mauritius. The Minister can refuse on national security or public policy grounds.

other: 4 years living together under the same roof in Mauritius.
Good character and language conditions apply for temporary permit holders.

sources.label: Mauritius Citizenship Act (as amended 2022)

routes.name: Naturalisation with investment
routes.summary: The Minister may accept 2 years of continuous residence instead of the normal residence periods if you invested at least USD 500,000 or a prescribed amount. What counts as an investment is not defined in the Act.

other: Discretionary. Details may sit in regulations.

sources.label: Mauritius Citizenship Act (as amended 2022)

routes.name: Registration of a child of a citizen
routes.summary: The Minister may register a minor child of a Mauritian citizen on a parent's or guardian's application. Adopted minors become citizens from the adoption order. The Act has no general birthright rule.

other: A child born abroad with another nationality to a Mauritian citizen has a 90 day registration window under the Act. Confirm the exact rule before relying on it.

sources.label: Mauritius Citizenship Act (as amended 2022)
